# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Open Second Brain - periodic reindex template
# interval: 30 minutes
#
# Pick ONE of the three paths below. The watchdog script is the
# common piece; both crontab and Hermes-cron rely on it.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------


## 1. Watchdog script - save to ~/.local/bin/osb-reindex.sh
##    (then chmod +x). Sources ~/.hermes/.env if present so the
##    embedding API key lands in the environment.

cat >~/.local/bin/osb-reindex.sh <<'OSBEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Pick up OPEN_SECOND_BRAIN_EMBEDDING_* from the Hermes env file
# if it exists. Other env files can be appended below.
if [[ -f "$HOME/.hermes/.env" ]]; then
  set -a; . "$HOME/.hermes/.env"; set +a
fi

out=$(o2b search reindex --embeddings --json)
# Emit the JSON line only when the reindex actually changed
# something. jq is preferred; fall back to grep when missing.
if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  changed=$(printf "%s" "$out" | jq -r ".stats.added + .stats.updated + .stats.deleted")
  if [ "$changed" != "0" ] && [ -n "$changed" ]; then
    printf "%s\n" "$out"
  fi
else
  if printf "%s" "$out" | grep -Eq '"(added|updated|deleted)"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*[1-9]'; then
    printf "%s\n" "$out"
  fi
fi
OSBEOF
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/osb-reindex.sh


## 2. Native crontab - open 'crontab -e' and append:

*/30 * * * *    ~/.local/bin/osb-reindex.sh


## 3. Hermes cron (preferred when Hermes is the embedding owner):

hermes cron create \
  --name osb-reindex \
  --schedule '*/30 * * * *' \
  --command "$HOME/.local/bin/osb-reindex.sh" \
  --no-agent


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# After install, verify with: o2b search status
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
